about: The falsifier: literal/**/src/**, identifier/**/src/** and comment/**/src/** carry the old word as banned since epoch 288, and at 289 lane B's code held it 451 times: in the names it exports (leafDigest, landLeaves, leafWithdrawals, vouchedLeaves), in what an act prints (no leaf is written, leaves released), in the region measure it read alone (leaves), and in its comments, several of them using the verb where they meant goes or keeps.
